title: PSEi falls below 5,800 as economic woes persist

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks continued to decline on Wednesday as inflation and economic growth concerns weakened investor confidence. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) shed 0.33 percent, or 19.42 points, to close at 5,795.14. READ: BMI cuts 2026 PH growth outlook to 3.3% on infra woes The PSEi opened at 5,826.48 and climbed to an intraday high of 5,842.03 before losing momentum. Michael Ricafort, chief economist at Rizal Commercial Banking Corp., said this marked the PSEi’s lowest level in nearly five months, or since May 29.
